title: Identify female patients who have abnormal total bilirubin (≥2.0) and also
question: Identify female patients who have abnormal total bilirubin (≥2.0) and also exhibit at least one of the following: either their uric acid is outside the normal range for females (UA > 6.5), or they have no thrombosis (Thrombosis = 0) combined with an abnormal CPK level (<250). For these patients, return their ID, sex, birthday, age as of today, total bilirubin, uric acid, CPK, and thrombosis status. Only include patients with valid laboratory and examination records.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    P."XCL_060" AS birthday,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(P."XCL_060")) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
    L."XCL_037" AS total_bilirubin,
    L."XCL_022" AS uric_acid,
    L."XCL_018" AS cpk,
    E."XCL_013" AS thrombosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E."XCL_001" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND L."XCL_037" >= 2.0
  AND (L."XCL_022" > 6.5 OR (E."XCL_013" = 0 AND L."XCL_018" < 250))
